android_mechanism: Per-row subqueries replacing a single aggregated query; fix computes all values in one query
bug_description: getFeedsWithCounts issues one SELECT COUNT(*) query per feed (N+1 pattern) every time the sidebar feed list refreshes — which happens after every article open/mark-read/refresh. With many subscriptions the sidebar update performs dozens of sequential RDB round-trips on the UI path.
fix_summary: A single grouped query (GROUP BY feed_id over unread articles) returns all feeds' unread counts at once.
trigger_steps: Subscribe to 15+ feeds and sync articles.
Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, disk, database).
Open and close 5 articles (each triggers a sidebar counts refresh).
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Number of RDB SELECT statements attributable to unread-count computation per sidebar refresh, and total refresh latency.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed: N queries per refresh (one per feed); fixed: 1. With 15+ feeds, sidebar refresh latency after article-open drops accordingly.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 app sched disk database -o /data/local/tmp/sr_counts.chtrace
